data.narrative:
Swarm Aero is a Seed-stage company in the Defense & Security sector that has raised $8M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, spanning Seed through Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $8M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier, implies a $20M valuation. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—yields a $400M median with a range of $125M to $1.0B. The stage-progression method captures near-term fundraising benchmarks, while the peer-median approach reflects the wide variance in Defense & Security exit multiples and investor appetite for frontier defense tech.

The triangulated range is $17M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $210M. This wide spread reflects material uncertainty regarding Swarm Aero's technology maturity, addressable market capture potential, and customer traction relative to better-capitalized peers. Resolution of go-to-market execution and early revenue generation would be critical to narrowing this range.
